about: Bridge (draft 1G) clips, 2026-11-03. Storyboard frames are skipped; every clip is an extra row so the old door clips keep their names. Old file: video-jobs-2026-10-23-old-door.json.

extra.motion: The camera does not move. Fixed to the back of the charging tracked machine: grass and chalk stream beneath the hull, dust billows either side, the green bunker door ahead grows larger as it races up the slope, the hull juddering. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, fast motion smears. The camera does not move.
extra.why: Kai 3 Nov: 'go with all of your recommended options' (1A: Ride the charge, then A's brake)

extra.motion: The camera does not move. The small television flickers, its red light trembling on the brick vault. The crowd watch in silence. One man shifts his weight; a woman slowly lifts her hand to her mouth. Fine grain alive. The camera does not move.
extra.why: Kai 3 Nov: 'go with all of your recommended options' (2B: Push in towards the screen)

extra.motion: The camera does not move. [00:00-00:01] a sudden jolt, the loudspeaker horn rattles on its bracket. [00:01-00:04] fine dust and grit sift down from the brick vault through the red light; one man slowly looks up at the ceiling while the others stand frozen. The camera does not move.
extra.why: Kai 3 Nov: 'go with all of your recommended options' (3A: Dust from the vault)

extra.motion: The camera does not move. The man presses his eye harder to the periscope, his hands tightening on its handles; slowly his frown loosens. Behind him the woman in the cream jumper takes one step closer. The camera does not move.
extra.why: Kai 3 Nov: 'go with all of your recommended options' (4A: He looks)

extra.motion: The camera does not move. Through the round periscope view: a thread of smoke rises from the burnt-out wreck and the crow settles its wings on it. [00:02-00:03] the little grey delivery robot's amber beacon pulses. [00:04-00:07] the delivery robot turns and trundles slowly out of the left of the circle, its torn bunting trailing. The camera does not move.
extra.why: Kai 3 Nov: 'go with all of your recommended options' (5A: Smoke, crow, Maddie leaves)
